description: List the Streams bulk parquet dumps manifest — coverage range, latest_finalized_cursor, and per-file metadata (block range, row count, size, sha256, signed URL). This is the cold backfill path for downloading all raw data; fetch the file URLs directly (e.g. with DuckDB). Requires the dumps base URL to be configured (SL_STREAMS_DUMPS_URL). For live reads use REST GET /v1/streams/events; for tip/lag use streams_tip.
name: streams_dumps
